domain: Founder supplies the exact newly purchased domain. No invented domain or database fixture substitutes for this acceptance.

steps.action: Founder purchases one test domain manually in the dedicated account, with accurate authorized registrant contact information.
steps.expected: Spaceship shows registered status and an actual expiration. No agent purchase or account transfer.

steps.action: Sign into StackEndBox as administrator and complete the existing authenticator challenge.
steps.expected: The admin authorization endpoint confirms the existing super-admin and AAL2. No MFA reset.

steps.action: Open /admin/domains and use Activate client and assign domain. Select an existing client by approved email, or provide the approved new client email, name and initial password.
steps.expected: API reads the domain and official contact from the primary account. The transaction saves Auth identity when needed, client membership and the unique domain assignment. No first-year payment fields or registrar purchase.

steps.action: Confirm contractual portal-management rights and the accurate holder arrangement.
steps.expected: Registered holder, portal client and registrar custody remain separate. An agency holder does not block authorized client access. No ownership transfer is claimed.

steps.action: The client confirms their branded account-ready invitation if new, then personally signs in.
steps.expected: Only their assigned domain appears, with provider status, actual expiry, countdown and actual auto-renew state. Existing-client passwords are unchanged.

steps.action: Refresh, sign out, sign in again and check the domain from a new session.
steps.expected: Persistent assignment and provider-confirmed expiry are unchanged. The account sees only its own website, service, billing and support records.

steps.action: Check the domain from a separate authorized client account and try client access to staff endpoints.
steps.expected: No cross-client domain access, and staff endpoints return HTTP 403. Database uniqueness rejects a second customer's assignment.

steps.action: Refresh supported DNS, nameserver and privacy details.
steps.expected: Read-only provider-backed data. All real write controls remain unavailable. Provider failures do not erase stored records.

steps.action: Admin records the exact verified supplier annual-renewal cost and source, then creates a renewal quote for the assigned client.
steps.expected: Quote uses verified supplier cost and mandatory supplier fees plus 30%. No price is invented. If registrar auto-renew is on or eligibility is unverified, the portal asks for administrator review. Live checkout remains disabled.
